all_text_content:
Verse of the Day
And it came to pass, that when all our enemies heard thereof, and all the heathen that were about us saw these things, they were much cast down in their own eyes: for they perceived that this work was wrought of our God.
Nehemiah 6:16
Quote of the Day
"Like our own discipleship, our eternal marriage is not a short-term experiment but a journey … of becoming who God desires us to become."
Elder Neil L. Andersen | 1 Apr 2026General Conference
